results.label: this tree ships the M112 trading-window rule (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
a caller that consulted no window publishes `not_consulted` — its own token, never mapped onto unset or inside
with no window selected the engine vetoes nothing and says so
inside the window the engine also vetoes nothing — the block is the boundary, not the feature
outside the window the candidate carries the refusal in its no-trade list — a veto, not a lower score
the veto IS the module sentence, so the engine invents no second wording and cannot drift from the rule
and it is a real veto: the same bars carry one more blocking reason than they did a moment ago
the sentence names the trader’s own window, zone, local time and the wait — never a generic phrase
and it carries his rationale for calling the boundary a cheat code
the filter states the window beside the killzone so a client renders it without parsing the veto
an unreadable window is its OWN reason on the filter, so a client can offer the repair rather than a countdown
and its veto is the module’s own repair sentence — the payload names the fix, it does not invent one
a window authored on a zone the trader has since changed refuses as well, naming both clocks
the test rows and their weights are identical with and without the window — M112 adds a veto, it retunes nothing
no candidate was silently converted to `ok` or to a better grade by the window either
the window filter sits beside the killzone filter rather than replacing it
and the module is consulted, never mutated: the engine holds the state object it was given, with no write path on it
the engine reads the window from its own ctx and does not go looking for an account row or a clock of its own

scope: M112 engine: outside the window is a veto, unset is nothing: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
